assumption_note: Each window is evaluated once, 1 minute after it opens, using the real Kalshi Yes/No quotes at that minute and Coinbase 1-minute / 5-minute / 15-minute / 1-hour BTC candles, plus a spot-derived fair probability from realized 1-minute volatility. Trades use a $4–$8 flat stake by signal strength (no 2× press) and the official quadratic taker fee. When a full 15-minute Kalshi bid path is available, early take-profit and cut-loss rules are applied on that path; otherwise the ticket is held to official Yes/No settlement. The live bot can also enter later in a window (on a 5-minute scan) and uses live order-book and taker-flow data as a market reader; those live-only prints are not in this backtest.
fee_note: Paper PnL includes Kalshi’s taker fee: ceil(0.07 × contracts × price × (1 − price)), rounded up to the next cent.
